admission.justification: A future reviewer change must not introduce a second judgment store/retention job that can diverge from authoritative leaf histories.

alternatives.option: Use retained Git history files as judgment authority without a second assessment-retention channel.
alternatives.reason: The approved appendix83 explicitly locates the retained judgments in Git; review_history.owner_rows reads owner attempt histories from the selected after index. The removed assessment pipeline supplies no second current authority.

alternatives.option: Add a separate assessment retention channel to preserve the same judgments.
alternatives.reason: That would duplicate the retained text/Git authority and revive a channel deliberately removed by the packet.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A new approved requirement establishes an independently owned assessment subject/source and its retention contract.

consequences: A future reviewer change must not introduce a second judgment store/retention job that can diverge from authoritative leaf histories.
No independent assessment-retention service, repository garbage-collection guarantee, archival lifetime measurement or fresh execution.
context: Approved MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6 require this by-design choice to be recorded, not deferred as a gap. Source obligation: MIK-R57@v2 by-design retained-history. This is the requirement-prescribed boundary, not a claim that an undocumented alternative was seriously weighed.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18/D47/D48; Curator records the specified boundary under constrains_future_work.
